zh-CN.title: 面板宽度，随空间而变
items: 桌面面板可点击外部关闭，关闭按钮移至右侧，背景保持清晰
通讯与菜单平滑调整分栏宽度，随导航展开折叠自适应；空间不足时仅展示详情并提供返回

en.title: Panels that fit your workspace
items: Click outside desktop panels to dismiss them, with a right-hand close button and no blurred backdrop
Contacts and menu panels resize smoothly with navigation changes; narrower workspaces show details with a back button
